name: Figma Tokens
description: Plugin for managing design system tokens directly in Figma. Sync colors, typography, spacing across files and export to code — bridges the gap between design and dev.
formattedText:
🔧 Figma Tokens
📂 Type: Design System Tool
💰 Pricing: Free/Freemium with paid tiers
💻 Platform: Figma Plugin

What it does: Manage your design system tokens (colors, typography, spacing) directly in Figma and sync them across files. Export to code in multiple formats — CSS, JSON, Tailwind — so your dev team stays in sync with design decisions.

Best for:
→ Teams building consistent design systems
→ Reducing handoff friction between design and code

🔗 https://tokens.studio/
